title: Quantitative Distortion Bounds and Formal Equilateral Exclusion for Eleven Points in Five-Dimensional l_1
decided_scope: Strict quantitative lower bound > 3089/3084 and rational upper bound <= 115/106 on the 11-point aspect ratio in l_1^5, plus Lean 4.33.1 kernel audit of e(l_1^5)=10
open_boundaries: Exact value of the unrestricted 11-point minimum aspect ratio in l_1^5 and Kusner's conjecture in dimensions d >= 7
